title: Miss Marjoribanks
summary: "Miss Marjoribanks" by Mrs. Oliphant is a novel published in 1866. It follows Lucilla Marjoribanks, a determined young woman who takes it upon herself to improve the social life of Carlingford, a provincial English town. Through wit and careful scheming, Lucilla navigates society, manages her household, and orchestrates the town's social events.
